title: ConnectInvokeRequest
description: Remote op call wrapping an existing ops request envelope as opaque JSON.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-session outbound from this sender; logical u64 capped at 2^53-1 (JSON-safe).

op.description: Open vocabulary. Core (documented, not enforced): upsert, promote, relate, check, assemble, project, compute.

payload.description: Opaque JSON — MUST be a full existing ops request envelope for the named op when targeting SPOKE ops.

auth.description: Optional mid-session proof blob; primary auth is hello. Shape method-specific when used.

signature.description: base64url (no padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized signed object (spoke-connect-invoke-request-jcs-v1).
